headline: Westpac Full-Year Profit Dips Amid Higher Credit Charges
summary: Westpac reported a drop in its full-year profit as higher credit charges offset ongoing growth.
why: Westpac is one of Australia's major commercial banks, making its financial results a key barometer for consumer credit health and the broader Australian housing and lending markets.

impacts.name: Westpac Banking Corp
impacts.why: Higher credit charges offset business growth, resulting in a lower full-year profit.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A dip in full-year profit driven by higher credit charges indicates increased provisioning for bad loans, weighing on investor sentiment for the bank.
